AAPL.rationale: Mega-cap platform/ecosystem peers; use as broad market expectation context, not perfect business-model comps.

MSFT.rationale: Platform/software/cloud peers with enterprise and hyperscale overlap.

NET.rationale: Cloud infrastructure/security/edge software peers; curated for metric comparison rather than GICS purity.

COIN.rationale: Crypto exchange, brokerage, payments, and market infrastructure peers; imperfect but useful for take-rate and volume context.

CRCL.rationale: Stablecoin/crypto infra comps are imperfect; use as public-market proxy set.

JPM.rationale: US money-center and capital-markets bank peers.

PDD.rationale: E-commerce/marketplace peers across China and global marketplace models.

NVDA.rationale: AI accelerator, semiconductor, foundry, and fabless peer context.
